text: AO «ВЭД-Мастер» (VED-Master JSC), the company behind the VED-Master payments brand, is owned by Kirill Sumenko per the Russian Saby (SBIS) company registry, which lists him in the entry's owners ('Владельцы') section as owner since 27 August 2026; Sumenko has been the company's general director since 29 October 2025.
short: AO VED-Master is owned by Kirill Sumenko, its general director

source.name: Saby (SBIS) company registry: AO «ВЭД-Мастер» (sbis.ru/contragents/9709114653/970901001)
source.note: Owners ('Владельцы') section of the registry card (the URL redirects to saby.ru/profile/9709114653-970901001). Russian quote translates as: 'Kirill Sumenko, Moscow, 502913125254, owner since 27.08.2026'. The same page states 'Генеральный директор: Суменко Кирилл Александрович' and 'Генеральный директор c 29.10.25'. The share amount and percentage are masked for unauthorised visitors; the section header shows one owner in total.
source.quote: Суменко Кирилл Александрович Москва 502913125254 С 27.08.26 является владельцем
